# Alejandro Sánchez · Senior Software Engineer

> Software engineer focused on system architecture: service boundaries, data flow and cloud infrastructure for scalable distributed systems and AI-powered features (LLM orchestration, retrieval, speech-to-text). Builds them hands-on with TypeScript, Node.js and Python. Founding Engineer at Entropy Systems. Based in Barcelona, Spain, EU.

Alejandro Sánchez (handle: aesbetancourt) works end-to-end across the stack, designing APIs and data layers, building the interfaces on top, and integrating the AI that makes them useful. This file summarizes his profile for language models and AI agents. The site is a single-page portfolio in English.

## Experience

- Founding Full Stack Engineer · Entropy Systems (2023 — Present): architected and delivered 3 SaaS products for ISO standards auditing, now used by ~40 client companies, in a team of 3–5 engineers; worked directly with client companies to gather requirements and measured product KPIs with SQL queries and dashboards; co-designed the agentic architecture and agent harness across AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI; defined the service architecture and delivered it hands-on in TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite, Fastify, Node.js, Prisma on PostgreSQL), plus Go for internal projects; built the identity and access layer on Better Auth and OpenID Connect (passkeys, 2FA, OIDC single sign-on, CASL authorization, hardened admin sign-in); built transaction handling for paid features and AI model usage on Stripe; LLM agent pipelines on AWS Bedrock processing ~2,000 audit documents per month and cutting manual review time by ~60%; a provider-agnostic speech-to-text (STT) engine on AWS Transcribe or Google Cloud Chirp 2 and Chirp 3, with no changes to calling services; replaced a Puppeteer HTML-to-PDF pipeline with a Typst-based document and report generation system, cutting generation time and resource usage by ~90%; owned 12 distributed services across AWS and GCP with 99.9% uptime, performance-tested in simulated environments before each release; Docker and CI/CD pipelines that cut deployment time from ~1 hour to ~10 minutes, enabling daily releases; mentored engineers on the team.
- Frontend Engineer · Vintra, Inc. (2022 — 2023): led migration of a ~80k-line video analytics codebase from legacy JavaScript to TypeScript, reducing production runtime errors by ~30%; introduced Vite and esbuild, cutting build time from ~3 min to ~20 s; gathered requirements directly from clients.
- UI Development Lead (full stack) · BITA GmbH (2022): led a team of 4 front-end engineers building 5 index and ETF analytics applications; introduced code reviews, linting and automated testing, raising test coverage from ~10% to ~70%; established shared component patterns.
- Full Stack Engineer · BITA GmbH (2021 — 2022): financial applications for index construction and ETF analytics; asynchronous RabbitMQ workflows ingesting ~1M market-data records per day; REST APIs in Python and Node.js; Go for internal index calculation projects.
- Application Developer · Intelix Synergy (2020 — 2021): built 3 internal systems used daily by ~200 employees, in Python and Node.js on Linux/NGINX; backend services in Java with Spring Boot.

## Projects

- ArchSim (website: https://aesbetancourt.dev/archsim/, source: https://github.com/aesbetancourt/archsim): open-source web app to practice software architecture with katas. An AI reviewer reads the diagram and the written trade-offs, scores seven dimensions from 1 to 5 and names the top risk. Works with Claude Code, OpenCode, the Anthropic API or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Includes a 43-page wiki, worked examples and a glossary. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Excalidraw and Tiptap.
- Blueprints (website: https://aesbetancourt.dev/blueprints/, source: https://github.com/aesbetancourt/blueprints): local-first desktop workspace for specs, notes and diagrams on a vault of plain files, with no database, account or cloud. Rich Markdown with slash commands and wiki-links, Typst documents with live preview and PDF export, Mermaid, Excalidraw, and JSON, YAML or CSV with a graph view. Git built in, full-text search with regex, frontmatter tags, 36 templates and a token count for AI coding agents. Built with Tauri v2 (Rust), React 19, TypeScript, TipTap, Typst and Zustand.
- docspawner (website: https://aesbetancourt.dev/docspawner/, source: https://github.com/aesbetancourt/docspawner): open-source stateless worker that renders a Typst template and JSON data to a PDF in one HTTP call. About 120 ms for a 3-page invoice, with no headless browser. Fixed render slots, a bounded queue with 503 and Retry-After, graceful shutdown, deterministic output and containment for untrusted templates. Hexagonal architecture with 13 ADRs. Built with TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, Typst and Docker.
